record.label: Reported spacetime savings over kickmix and Häner
record.statement: The paper reports a cost reduction of about $11\%$ relative to the circuit of cost $415{,}200$ that could still be expressed in kickmix, and a factor of about 290 relative to the Häner baseline estimate.
record.boundary: The 100-qubit circuit has a proved spacetime bound of $369{,}800$. The paper’s kickmix cost is $415{,}200$, giving a reduction of at least $10.9\%$ against that value. The ratio of the authors’ partial Häner estimate to the proved bound is about $291.89$. The baseline estimate uses the reported looser accuracy of about $10^{-6}$.
